# Example Store Ceramics

> Small pottery studio in Galle Fort, Sri Lanka, making handmade stoneware mugs, gift sets and custom mugs, and running beginner pottery workshops. Delivery within Sri Lanka only.

## Shop
- [Handmade mugs](https://example-store.com/collections/mugs/): all mugs with prices
- [Blue ceramic mug](https://example-store.com/products/blue-ceramic-mug/): 350 ml, LKR 4,500
- [Speckled stoneware mug](https://example-store.com/products/speckled-stoneware-mug/): 400 ml, LKR 4,900
- [Mug gift set](https://example-store.com/products/gift-set/): two mugs in a gift box, LKR 12,500

## Services and prices
- [Services](https://example-store.com/services/): custom mugs (minimum 12) and pottery workshops
- [Pricing](https://example-store.com/pricing/): all prices and delivery costs

- [About](https://example-store.com/about/): our story and how we make mugs
- [FAQ](https://example-store.com/faq/): care, delivery, returns, workshops
